text:
Rickard Rakell is the name on every trade board this week. Elliotte Friedman linked Ottawa to him and Bryan Rust, Senators GM Steve Staios was spotted watching the Penguins in Nashville, and ClutchPoints wrote that he had turned down a move to Chicago. Nothing has happened yet, but the 33-year-old is playing like a player teams want.

He has 9 goals in 24 games and 10.5 expected goals, the most chance-heavy profile of his recent seasons, with 109 shot attempts and a top-34 rank in our wins added. His last ten games produced 5 goals on 5.5 expected, including a two-goal night against St. Louis with 1.5 expected goals on its own.

What he lacks is help. Pittsburgh has scored 5.3 fewer goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice, and the team has lost eight of his last ten. His five-on-five numbers are below break-even. For a contender, that reads like a scorer stuck on a bad team; for Pittsburgh, it's the case for selling.
